obligations.source_text: The upper garment, waist, crotch/rise, both fitted legs, leg openings/hems, and full silhouette must all remain clearly inspectable in one frame.

bindings.upper_to_waist_continuity_phrase: the fitted upper garment and waist remain one continuous unit
bindings.waist_to_crotch_continuity_phrase: the same garment continues from the waist through a visible crotch
bindings.two_fitted_leg_openings_phrase: a visible inseam separates two fitted unitard legs
bindings.selected_short_or_long_length_phrase: both unitard legs keep one coherent selected short or long length
bindings.bodysuit_separates_romper_confound_contr: a bodysuit with separate shorts, matching separates, a dress, or loose romper cannot substitute
